execution_receipt.receipt_id: rcpt_ + 32 random hex via native CSPRNG; caller can never submit
execution_receipt.receipt_digest: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of identity fields; validated on load and read-back

persistence_phases.accepted: durably written after CP7 plan reservation + approval consumption, before spawn
persistence_phases.spawn_started: durably written immediately after OS process creation, before waiting for exit
persistence_phases.completed: exit code, timeout/cancel, bounded output digests
persistence_phases.spawn_failed: every pre-spawn gate failure; provably no process
persistence_phases.unknown_after_crash: restart migration of any mid-flight receipt

crash_classification.spawn_started_without_completion_on_rest: unknown_after_crash (effect may exist; never auto-success or auto-no-effect)

store.serialization: store mutex + exclusive OS file lock (CP7 shared lock)
store.corrupt_store: BROKER_RECEIPT_STORE_CORRUPT; never deleted, never reset empty; broker execute and read-back fail closed

fundamental_rule.original_stdout_use: audit only (bounded digests in receipt); locator hints never outcome truth

readback_runner.api: performReadback({ receipt_id }) crate-internal; no public Tauri command
readback_runner.authority: receipt_id -> trusted native ReceiptStore lookup; caller JSON results are never authority
readback_runner.verification_linkage: trusted copies from the approved ExecutionPlan; verification-plan digest bound by CP7 approval
readback_runner.registry: trusted compiled registry only; IPC caller, skills and LLM cannot register
readback_runner.binding_rule: risk_level=low AND side_effect_class=read_only AND required_authority=L0; else READBACK_BINDING_NOT_READ_ONLY
readback_runner.spawn_containment: CP3 rules unchanged: no shell, trusted executable, cwd allowlist, env allowlist, output bounds, process-tree kill

retry_primitive.attempt_id: single-use, persisted before spawn (write-ahead), replay-proof across restart
retry_primitive.never_spawned: accepted/spawn_failed receipts are not read-back eligible (trusted lifecycle decides, not the caller)

structured_parser.truncation_rule: any stream truncation upgrades parser_status to truncated; never reported complete
structured_parser.redaction: CP3 redaction applies; GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / Authorization / cookies never enter payloads

observation_envelope.verified_field: absent by design; semantic comparison belongs to Brain evaluator
